text:
support-bot: [ALERT] multiple 502/504s detected for /v1/generate in us-east-1 over the last 7m. p95 latency jumped to ~12s, error rate ~4.2% :rotating_light:

anita: seeing customer escalations too — at least 4 enterprise accounts reporting timeouts and streaming disconnects

liam: digging into ingress/proxy logs now, seeing repeated 'connection reset by peer' upstream from runtime pods (grpc)

jordan: quick repro from my laptop (intermittent):
```
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"rwd/fast-1","input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate
```

mike: I can repro too, sometimes returns 502, sometimes long poll then 504. Proxy trace: `upstream reset` + runtime SIGPIPE in same window

anita: timeline — did anything change around 03:00-03:15 UTC? I see a runtime canary deploy at 03:08 for v1.3.7 config tweaks

liam: yes, canary rolled at 03:08. Autoscaler emitted several scale-up events ~03:10-03:13. Node churn + heavy KV cache priming seen

jordan: stack snippets from runtime pod: `oom-kill` not obvious, but kv-cache allocation spikes and gRPC conn closures line up

mike: working mitigation: routing new requests to previous runtime pool (v1.3.6), enabling existing fallback model-variant for affected routes

anita: Ops, can we drain suspect nodes and spin up warmed nodes in us-east-1? Also notify support for customer comms @mike

mike: scaling +4 GPU nodes now, initiating drain on 2 suspect pods. Enabling fallback routing rule for /v1/generate to quantized variant for 10m window

support-bot: created incident ticket INC-2026-9150 and paged oncall

ryan: oncall here. I've attached trace: https://traces.redwood/internal/trace/915000 — looking at heap/alloc patterns, runtime shows large short-lived allocations during warmup

ryan: initial hypothesis: canary runtime memory config reduced headroom; during autoscale warmup KV cache allocation causes transient OOMs or forced restarts leading to upstream conn resets

liam: proposed immediate action items:
1) rollback runtime canary v1.3.7 -> v1.3.6 (anita + ops)
2) increase autoscaler buffer and add graceful warmup delay (mike + infra)
3) add proactive KV-cache pre-warm hook on scale-up (engineering)
4) auto-enable fallback variant when 5xx > 3% for 2m on critical endpoints (product + infra)

anita: I'll draft customer messages for 4 impacted accounts — explain mitigation and ETA ~30m, offer dedicated follow-up call

mike: creating PR to bump memory headroom and add warmup hook, will link in incident ticket

jordan: collecting repro curl samples + exact proxy/log fingerprints for postmortem

liam: volunteering to own postmortem and follow-through on action items — will include queries, repro steps, and timeline

anita: thanks — once stable, we'll close incident and run retro. Good catch everyone. :thumbsup:
